# Inventory validator (candidate mutation: sorted-aware)

Like the baseline, but the candidate first sorts entries by id then checks
that every `name=` is preceded by an `id=`.
Exits 0 if all entries have ids, 1 otherwise.

Hypothesis under test: sorting catches a class of missing-id defects that the
sequential validator misses.
This is an EXPERIMENTAL candidate. It must NOT be promoted to Stable without
Prime gate + evidence + (if mandatory) challenger.
